items.title: Tilak Varma and Nitish Kumar Reddy power India to a second T20I win
items.text: India chased New Zealand's 181-run target in Christchurch, reaching 184 for six to win by four wickets and take a 2–0 lead in the five-match series. Tilak Varma made 51 from 26 balls, and Nitish Kumar Reddy scored 26 from 13 as the pair added 69 runs for the seventh wicket.

items.title: PM Modi to inaugurate RBI data centre and cybersecurity institute in Bhubaneswar
items.text: During his 25 October visit to Varanasi and Bhubaneswar, Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the Reserve Bank of India's Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar. The institute will focus on cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, quantum computing and other emerging technologies relevant to banking.

items.title: Madhya Pradesh receives over ₹5,800 crore in semiconductor and technology proposals
items.text: At the MP Semiconductor Summit 2026 in Indore, the state reported technology and semiconductor investment proposals worth more than ₹5,800 crore, with potential to create over 10,000 jobs. The state also announced plans for semiconductor and photonics and quantum technology centres, alongside industry partnerships and skills development.

items.title: India and Germany discuss six areas for industrial technology cooperation
items.text: During Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal's visit to Germany, officials and industry representatives discussed collaboration in microelectronics, power electronics, logistics, smart manufacturing, industrial innovation and battery technologies. The discussions included research partnerships linking industry, academia and research institutions; no specific new investment commitments were announced.

items.title: IMD issues heavy-rain alerts for Tamil Nadu and Kerala
items.text: The India Meteorological Department forecast heavy to very heavy rainfall, with isolated extremely heavy downpours, across Kerala, Mahe, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal on 25 October. Alerts also covered several other regions, with thunderstorms, lightning, gusty winds and squally conditions expected in some coastal areas.
